verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਗੁਰਸਰਣੀ ਆਏ।
verses.translit_en: gurmukh sukh fal paiaa saadhasa(n)gat gursaranee aae|

en.bdb: Those gurmukhs who have gone into the shelter of the holy congretation have attained the pleasure fruit.

verses.gurmukhi: ਧ੍ਰੂ ਪ੍ਰਹਿਲਾਦੁ ਵਖਾਣੀਅਨਿ ਅੰਬਰੀਕੁ ਬਲਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਸਬਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: dhraoo prahilaadh vakhaaneean a(n)bareek bal bhagat sabaae|

en.bdb: These devotees are Dhruv, Prahalad, Ambaris, Bali, Janak, Jaidev, Valmilci et al.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਨਕਾਦਿਕ ਜੈਦੇਉ ਜਗਿ ਬਾਲਮੀਕੁ ਸਤਿਸੰਗ ਤਰਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: sanakaadhik jaidheau jag baalameek satisa(n)g taraae|

en.bdb: They have gone across through the holy congregation. Bent, Trilochan, Namdev, Dhanna,

verses.gurmukhi: ਬੇਣੁ ਤਿਲੋਚਨੁ ਨਾਮਦੇਉ ਧੰਨਾ ਸਧਨਾ ਭਗਤ ਸਦਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: ben tilochan naamadheau dha(n)naa sadhanaa bhagat sadhaae|

en.bdb: Sadhana have also been called saints. Kabir is accepted as bhagat, the devotee, and Ravidas,

verses.gurmukhi: ਭਗਤੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਵਖਾਣੀਐ ਜਨ ਰਵਿਦਾਸੁ ਬਿਦਰ ਗੁਰੁ ਭਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: bhagat kabeer vakhaaneeaai jan ravidhaas bidhar gur bhaae|

en.bdb: Vidur et al. have also been loved by the Lord. Whether born in high or the low caste,

verses.gurmukhi: ਜਾਤਿ ਅਜਾਤਿ ਸਨਾਤਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਚਰਣ ਕਵਲ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: jaat ajaat sanaat vich gurmukh charan kaval chit laae|

en.bdb: The gurmukh who has adopted the lotus feet in his heart,
Decimating his ego has come to be known (as devotee).
